rationale:
Second batch of handler-side commit_sha standardisation for bugs_open/334 (RFC_029 step 5's real gate), following migration 519 (page-rerender, submitted, awaiting verdict). Same mechanism, same council-approved shape: webdesign-agent is a real, live bdl handler (confirmed against site_work_items.handler_agent, the top-level dispatch column, not a static list) with its own direct git_commit step. Same judgement-call shape as section-editor: webdesign-agent has TWO git-touching events — its own direct CSS commit (deploy_css, output_field css_deployed) and a LATER call to site-asset-renderer (call_asset_renderer, output_field asset_renderer_result, "Render and deploy snippets.js" — a JS-bundle side-effect, not the item's own deliverable). Maps to css_deployed (the design work item's own commit) on the same principle. site-asset-renderer itself has 0 occurrences as a live bdl handler, so it is out of this lane's scope entirely, not merely deferred.

Same conversion as 519 and the same reason it is required, not merely convenient: webdesign-agent's `complete` step currently uses `output_fields` (list mode), which uses each entry as both the extraction path and the response key — a dotted path added to the list would produce a response key that is that literal string, invisible to any dot-path reader. `result_mapping` is the only mode that builds an independently-named target<-source map, and it is mutually exclusive with `output_fields`. So this is a controlled conversion: every currently-exposed field re-declared as an identity mapping (byte-identical response for existing readers), plus one new `commit_sha` entry.

2. This is one of ~7 real handlers; the flip itself is not touched by this submission. bdl still resolves commit_sha via the search until every handler converts and the bugfix_315 lane adds its wire afterward.

A COEXISTING, UNRELATED FINDING on webdesign-agent specifically: an unclaimed needs_diagnosis item (site_work_items id 7df0cc7a, failed on CHILD_ORCHESTRATION_FAILED before a 090 run ever executed) describes design-repair handlers (webdesign-agent, component-template-fixer, color-variable-fixer) sometimes completing with a bogus four-key design-token result and NO actual page write — a different, real defect about which path gets taken.
